shapeSummary: Stamped clevis-style U-bracket: a 26x40 mm base plate 3 mm thick with two 6.5 mm through holes, two 3 mm thick upright ears 30 mm high, and a 10 mm cross pin spanning both ears near the end of the channel. The pin clip is omitted.
warnings: No dimensions are given except the 10 mm pin diameter. All other sizes are visual estimates.
Ear height (30 mm) and thickness (3 mm) are guessed, so the supplied 50 mm bounding-box height was not followed.
Pin position (Y=22, Z=10) and length (30 mm) are estimated.
Base hole diameter (6.5 mm) and positions are estimated. The holes may be slotted, but this is unclear, so they are modeled as round.
The pin clip/cotter ring, the pin head and the stamped edge radii and tapering are not modeled.
The pin is unioned with the ears, so no separate pin hole is cut.
cadquery:
base = cq.Workplane('XY').box(26, 3, 40, centered=(True, False, True))
ear_l = cq.Workplane('XY').box(3, 30, 40, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((-11.5, 0, 0))
ear_r = cq.Workplane('XY').box(3, 30, 40, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((11.5, 0, 0))
part = base.union(ear_l).union(ear_r)
# 10 mm cross pin through both ears (axis X)
pin = cq.Workplane('YZ').center(22, 10).circle(5).extrude(15, both=True)
part = part.union(pin)
# two base mounting holes (axis Y)
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints([(0, -6), (0, -16)]).circle(3.25).extrude(10, both=True)
part = part.cut(holes)
